text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Kitasan Black managed to run in
the 
Japanese Derby, she showed severe 
exhaustion following the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A tough 2,400-meter race on a GⅠ stage. 
Doubts regarding her distance aptitudes 
began to arise from all around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final leg of the Classic Triple
Crown, the Kikuka Sho,
is an even longer-distance 
race than today's.
At this crucial moment, 
a new wave of anxiety began to surface.
